verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of versioned public APIs or a deprecation policy for Temporal's APIs or SDKs. Worker Versioning (Pinned/Auto-Upgrade behaviors) covers versioning of the user's own Workflow code across Worker deployments, which is an adjacent feature rather than API versioning. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
